about_the_game:
Hi everyone!

I'm Andreas, and I'm so happy to finally present my first ever released game.

This project has been really fun, and I look forward to any feedback I receive which I am commited to use to further improve the gameplay, and make it as enjoyable as possible!

Unearth History, build a Museum, uncover a Secret.

You’ve just been hired as the museum manager for a prestigious yet mysterious institution. Your job? Travel across remote islands, dig up ancient artifacts, and curate the most impressive museum the world has ever seen!

But there’s more to this job than meets the eye…

Explore, Dig, and Discover

  • Set sail to different islands, each hiding unique artifacts waiting to be unearthed.

  • Upgrade your tools to become more efficient.

  • Clean, restore, and showcase your findings to attract visitors and earn income.

A Story Beneath the Surface…

  • What if your museum wasn’t just about history?

  • As you collect more artifacts, a hidden conspiracy begins to unfold…

  • Are you preserving history or rewriting it? Who really owns the past?

Key Features

  • Dig & Discover: Hunt for rare artifacts across a variety of islands.

  • Museum Tycoon Lite: Place, display, and grow your museum for more visitors & income.

  • Upgrade Your Tools: Better gear gives higher efficiency.

  • Steam Achievements & Cloud Saves (Planned)

  • A Mystery to Unravel: The more you dig, the darker the truth becomes…

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
